reason: Both skills teleport the agent to a specified room and are functionally interchangeable for navigation.
Both perform a 'look around' or survey of the current room to list visible objects.
Both scan the current location and output a detailed room description for situational awareness.
Temperature measurement is a specific case of the more general measurement-taking skill.
A measurement-taker produces a numeric value that a threshold evaluator then consumes to decide a conditional outcome.
Conditional box placement requires a threshold evaluation result to decide which container to use.
Both place an object into containers based on a numeric condition or threshold.
Building a circuit relies on the ability to connect components with the connector skill.
Conductivity testing integrates a completed circuit built by the circuit-builder to observe a light bulb reaction.
Both pick up an object from the environment and move it into the agent's inventory.
After retrieving a recipe document, the instruction-reader skill is used to extract and parse its contents.
Pot preparation requires soil first obtained by the soil-extraction skill.
Planting coordination depends on having a prepared pot available.
Focusing on plant growth only makes sense after a seed has been planted by the planting-coordinator.
Monitoring plant development often pairs a focus action with timed waits to allow growth.
Both skills retrieve a target item or substance from a container into the agent's inventory.
Fetching a specific tool is a specialized instance of the more general item-fetching skill.
